The march opening uses repeated accented/staccato eighth notes and rests; rehearsal A moves to softer connected phrases with triplets and chromatic neighbor figures. The piano accompaniment carries repeated block chords and bass motion under the solo, then short connecting fills. The excerpt includes a long solo rest beginning around bar 36, placing exposed continuity with the accompaniment.
